From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-11-12T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Setup & runbook for ML coding session — Samir Khanna

Team —

We have Samir Khanna on the schedule for an ML Engineer coding screen on Monday 2026-11-15, 11:00–12:00 PT. Rebecca from TalentBridge will proctor, but we need to own the interviewer logistics and the environment. I've attached a one-page runbook (runbook-ml-screen-v1.pdf) and Samir's resume. Please review and confirm the lineup below: 

- Dev (lead interviewer): model evaluation problem + follow-up design questions (30m)
- Laura (systems): inference/serving question + short add-on (20m)
- Mina (safety/metrics): quick discussion on evaluation metrics and tradeoffs (10m)

Platform and infra:
- CoderPad session: https://coderpad.io/session/6a2f9b (we will use the Python 3.10 environment)
- Please ensure the CoderPad runs pytest locally — tests are included in the runbook.
- Candidate will have access to a notebook scaffold in the Drive folder linked below.

Ask:
1) Confirm you can make the slot (11:00–12:00 PT 2026-11-15) or propose swap windows by EOD Friday.
2) If you plan to use any extra libs (numpy/pandas/scikit), declare here so I can pre-install in the pad.
3) Post-interview: add a brief debrief note and scorecard to the Hire spreadsheet; I want a 30-minute debrief block same day (12:30 PT) if possible.

Attach: runbook-ml-screen-v1.pdf, samir_khanna_resume.pdf

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Applied ML Hiring
Redwood Inference

+1 for the slot — confirmed.
I pulled the runbook. I will own the model evaluation problem and will keep the first 25–30 minutes hands-on.
I plan to use numpy and scikit-learn only (no heavy dependencies). That should be fine in CoderPad; I'll add a short helper in the pad (data loaders + test harness).
Also: can someone paste the calendar invite link here? I want to make sure my calendar has the candidate contact details (email).

Quick final notes after the session — posting here so folks have the thread for the debrief and scorecards: 

- Session went as planned; CoderPad environment worked with numpy + scikit installed (Dev, thanks for the helper harness).
- Candidate finished the main task and we ran the hidden tests in the pad; two failing edge-case tests that Laura highlighted (one around missing values).
- Mina, please paste your notes on evaluation metrics and the fairness flags; Laura, please add the system/latency follow-ups.

Per my earlier ask, I've created a 30-minute debrief block at 12:30 PT (calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood_session_20261114). If that's not possible, reply here with your available times today.

Next steps for hiring coordinator: Rebecca, please send Samir the follow-up timeline and any feedback we can share (high-level) after our debrief.

Thanks all — Markus
